items.why: Turns, turnabouts, parking, lane use, and passing rules are declarative recall served by standard flashcards and quizzes; no separate practice mode is needed.

sections.heading: C - General Driving
sections.markdown:
## C - General Driving

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: A01
Turns start with corner searches for controls, walkers, and cars plus a signal, hold the lane nearest your direction, sight through to the farthest path point, then finish with smooth speed, a cancelled signal, and a rear check, signaling 100 feet ahead of intersection turns and never copying a leader's blinker unless you also turn [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: A01
Right turns hug the right-most lane edge without a left swing, left turns yield to oncoming traffic from the left-most edge, and multi-lane turns pick one lane and stay married to it until done [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: A02
A turnabout legally reverses direction through a street, alley, or driveway when circling the block is impractical, demanding 500 feet of visibility each way before you signal right, stop, and check sides and rear [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: A02
Back to the driveway's near edge, crank fully right while creeping back, center and straighten to a stop, and on a two-lane road hug right of the center line or your own side when unmarked [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: A02
Shift to drive, check both ways, and when clear signal left into the proper lane with matching speed, mastering this move for the skills test [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: A02
Slow at every intersection and hunt for devices, crossing traffic, walkers and cyclists, road conditions, and blind corners, trusting no one to obey or yield [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: A02
After stopping, scan crossing traffic and bikes with a left-right-left sweep, and on a fresh green confirm a clear path plus a gap wide enough to cross, land in lane, and reach speed [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: A02
Look both ways even when cross traffic faces red or stop signs, edge out slowly past buildings or parked rows, wait out lane-blocking views, and never nose into the next lane to peek [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: A02
Never count on shared space or extra room, and never trust an active turn signal, since its driver may pass you first or simply have forgotten it [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: A03
Roundabouts circle traffic counterclockwise around a raised island with entering cars yielding to circulating ones, so slow down, heed the warning sign, enter against the clock, then signal and take your exit [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: A03
Stop for any halted school or church bus loading or unloading on any roadway, since children surprise, and stay stopped until every person clears and the bus rolls [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: A03
The bus stop binds both directions on every road except opposite-side travel on a four-or-more-lane road split by an elevated barrier or unpaved median, and no vehicle may pass a bus flashing its stop arm and lights [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: A03
Parked cars must never menace, so use marked areas, sit far from traffic flow or tight to the curb, respect signed, painted, and colored-curb bans, and begin perpendicular entries by spotting a space, checking traffic, and signaling [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: A04
Finish perpendicular entries by creeping centered to the space front and securing the car, and exit by backing straight until your front bumper clears the neighbor, then cranking toward the rear's path before driving off smooth and straight [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec07-F15 | anchor: A04
Parallel entries start with space, traffic, and signal, then reverse while gazing rearward with quick wheel work until your front bumper lines with the lead car's rear bumper [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec07-F16 | anchor: A04
Center into the slot, stop short of the rear bumper, drive-adjust, immobilize with brake and park or reverse gear, slip out curbside, and obey the law: engine off, key out, doors locked [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec07-F17 | anchor: A04
Parallel exits brake and back toward the rear car, then check, signal, and drive forward into the lane once the door post clears the lead car's rear bumper, re-reversing short of clearance, a maneuver to master for skills day [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec07-F18 | anchor: A05
Aim hill-parked wheels to catch the curb if you roll, or off the road where curbless, then kill the engine, pocket the key, and lock up even for short stops [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-F19 | anchor: A05
Handicapped bays serve only permitted vehicles carrying a disabled person, with violators fined and applicants directed to the County Clerk for decals or plates [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-F20 | anchor: A05
Three-or-more lanes give middles to through traffic, the left to passers and left-turners, and the right to slower, entering, and right-turning drivers, while two-lane roads flow smoothest right with the left saved for passing, and camping the left lane of a limited-access highway breaks the law [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-F21 | anchor: A05
Turn into your nearest lane, with multi-lane lefts starting nearest center and rights nearest curb before any later change, loop around when you miss a turn, and follow through once committed in an intersection since last-second swerves collide [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-F22 | anchor: A05
Lane changes open with mirrors and an over-the-shoulder blind-spot check toward your move [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-F23 | anchor: A06
Complete the change by spotting a gap, signaling, glancing again, and steering in at matched speed [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-F24 | anchor: A06
Join freeways via the acceleration lane at traffic speed through a chosen gap with a cancelled signal, yielding to traffic already there [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-F25 | anchor: A06
Plan exits early by sliding to the exit lane, holding highway speed, then signaling into the deceleration lane and slowing to its posted limit [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-F26 | anchor: A06
Pass on the left as a rule with the left-most lane reserved for it, pass right only when truly safe since right-side cars hide and surprise, and never leave the roadway unless the passed car fully stops and the move stays safe [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-F27 | anchor: A06
A solid line on your side of a broken line bans passing while a solid yellow left of a broken yellow permits it with no oncoming traffic and sign approval, and Kentucky law demands the pass finish before any no-passing zone and before closing within 200 feet of oncoming cars [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-F28 | anchor: A07
Pass briskly yet safely with oncoming, mirror, and shoulder checks plus a signal, glide over at adjusted speed, hold out until the passed car's full front fills your rearview, signal back, and merge smooth [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec07-F29 | anchor: A07
Weigh space at hills, curves, intersections, and obstacles, treat every blind hill or curve as hiding oncoming traffic and never start there, and shun passing near crossroads, crowds, shops, schools, parks, and crossings where blocked views and side entries ambush [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec07-F30 | anchor: A07
Pull out only with room to return, declining multi-car gambles and borrowed space, and return once the passed car shows in your outside mirror; give same-direction bikes and scooters a full left-lane shift when lanes allow or 3 feet of left-side room on single lanes, cross the center even past no-passing paint when the left runs clear, and stay cautious when 3 feet will not fit [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec07-F31 | anchor: A07
When overtaken, hold your lane, and Kentucky law orders you to yield right to the passer while all road users cooperate for clearance [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0056]
